summary_zh: 空间准入及离线双来源交接在限定范围通过独立审核；未发现阻止本次整合的问题。旧输出限制、锁恢复与清理发现不在本次关闭范围。
summary_en: Storage admission and offline dual-source handoff pass independent review within scope; no blocking integration findings identified. Existing output-limit, lock-recovery and cleanup findings are not closed by this review.
limitations_zh: 空间检查是快照，不是磁盘预留；检查后仍可能ENOSPC。
URL校验是导入结构校验，不是DNS/重定向SSRF防护或官网所有权证明。
未复跑全部45项父测试，独立运行其中21项；未更改三个旧候选文件。
未验证实采真实性、生产发布、发送资格或无人值守周期。
limitations_en: Space checks are snapshots, not reservations; ENOSPC can still follow admission.
URL checks validate imported structure, not DNS/redirect SSRF protection or website ownership.
Independently ran 21 tests, not the entire parent 45-test suite; three historical candidate files were unchanged.
No live collection truth, production release, send eligibility or unattended cycle was validated.
